# Emily Berkah

> Showroom in Makassar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia, selling new electric motorcycles, electric bicycles and scooters (operated by UD Emily). All purchases are completed in the showroom.

- Address: Jl. Bacan No. 5, Makassar 90174, Sulawesi Selatan, Indonesia
- Opening hours: Monday–Saturday 08:30–16:30 WITA
- WhatsApp: +62 895-4127-55181
- Languages: Indonesian (main site), English

## Pages

- [Emily Berkah (Indonesian)](https://emilyberkah.levobox.com/): catalogue with specs and prices, FAQ, location
- [Emily Berkah (English)](https://emilyberkah.levobox.com/en/): the same catalogue in English

## Models

- Electric motorcycles: Volta 401, Volta Cyrus, Uwinfly T5, Uwinfly Blue Whale, Uwinfly Romeo Plus (three-wheeler)
- Electric bicycles: Samebike 20LVXD30, Xiaomi HIMO Z16, Antelope Wind
- Scooter: Seal Up Q8 (non-electric push scooter)

All units are new. Stock is limited per colour; availability and final prices are confirmed via WhatsApp or in the showroom.
